newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy May CPI seen 1.5/1.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy May CPI seen 1.5/1.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian consumer prices were seen at 1.5/1.6 percent year-on-year in May and 0.2/0.3 percent month-on- month, according to analysts' estimates after preliminary data from 11 sample Italian cities.
Analysts had forecast the year-on-year rate at 1.5 percent and the month-on-month rate at 0.2 percent following 1.7 percent and 0.1 percent respectively in April.
The 11 cities have a combined weighting of 75.66 percent on the national index. Final CPI data will be published on June 4.
If the 1.5 percent rate is confirmed by the final figures it will be the lowest level of Italian inflation since February 1969, when the year-on-year rate was 1.4 percent.
